onboardingChecklist.title: Store webhookSecret securely
onboardingChecklist.action: Copy webhookSecret from this JSON into your secrets manager as INTEGRATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Do not commit it.
onboardingChecklist.doneWhen: Secret is in vault / env of the consumer only

onboardingChecklist.title: Register webhook endpoints
onboardingChecklist.action: Point your Stripe (or payment) webhook at https://api.omnigrouptech.com/api/v1/payments/webhooks/stripe. Point internal job status consumers at deliverableReady. Use customIngress for your own systems.
onboardingChecklist.doneWhen: Provider dashboard shows endpoint + signing secret configured

onboardingChecklist.title: Add third-party API keys (only when you go live)
onboardingChecklist.action: Fill envMap keys that apply (Stripe, email, OpenRouter, etc.). Keys are NOT pre-connected â this pack documents how to wire them.
onboardingChecklist.doneWhen: Required env vars set in staging; unused keys left blank

onboardingChecklist.title: Verify HMAC + retry policy
onboardingChecklist.action: Implement signature check on inbound webhooks; apply retryPolicy (exponential backoff + dead-letter). Send Idempotency-Key on payment-confirm retries.
onboardingChecklist.doneWhen: Staging echo returns 2xx; failed deliveries land in DLQ after maxAttempts

onboardingChecklist.title: Sandbox end-to-end
onboardingChecklist.action: Run Auth â CRM contact â payment reference â payment.completed â artifact unlock using sampleEvents payloads.
onboardingChecklist.doneWhen: E2E green in staging with sandbox keys only

onboardingChecklist.title: Production cutover
onboardingChecklist.action: Rotate webhookSecret, swap live keys, disable sandbox endpoints, monitor p95 latency and failed fulfillment count for 24h.
onboardingChecklist.doneWhen: Live purchase produces downloadable artifacts; rollback flag documented
